title: Illinois Legislative Staff Intern Program (ILSIP)
pay_text: $3,300 per month stipend, plus tuition, fees and textbooks covered
who_text: People who will have finished a bachelor's degree before the September 1 start date
description: Interns work for 10 months, September 1 to June 30, with legislative staff in the Illinois General Assembly in Springfield. You earn a monthly stipend and graduate credit, and the program covers tuition, fees and textbooks.

title: Illinois Youth Investment Program (IYIP)
pay_text: Paid job placements; summer wages subsidized for up to 3 months
who_text: Illinois residents ages 16 to 24 who are low income or face barriers such as homelessness, disability, or no work experience
description: This state program helps young people get paid summer and longer term jobs, apprenticeships, and job training. It can also help with needs like transportation. You apply through a local partner agency listed on Illinois workNet.

title: Chicago Youth Works (formerly One Summer Chicago)
sponsor: City of Chicago Department of Family and Support Services
pay_text: Paid stipend for ages 14 to 15; paid summer jobs for ages 16 to 24
description: Chicago's city program offers summer jobs and career exploration for young people. Ages 14 and 15 join Chicagobility for six weeks of paid activities, and ages 16 to 24 can get summer job placements that run at least six weeks from June into late July or August.
